items.name: lib-db
items.title: Prisma Client Singleton
items.description: The global-cached PrismaClient every app needs — a fresh client per hot-reload exhausts connections in dev. Import { prisma } from '@/lib/db'.

items.name: script-rebuild-and-verify
items.title: Rebuild And Verify (local container)
items.description: Rebuilds a local containerized app and proves it serves: bounded health wait then a route sweep, so the exit code reflects the ROUTES rather than the build. Universal item — installs into any repo, framework-agnostic. Per-repo values live in scripts/verify.env, so the script itself stays identical everywhere.

items.name: config-vitest
items.title: Vitest Config
items.description: The platform's Vitest setup for a Next App Router + React 19 app: node environment by default (server actions and pure logic), jsdom opted into per file, the @/* alias resolved from tsconfig, and jest-dom matchers loaded. Universal item — lands vitest.config.ts + vitest.setup.ts at the repo root.

items.name: config-eslint
items.title: ESLint Config
items.description: Flat ESLint config for a Next.js app: core-web-vitals + typescript, with eslint-config-next's default ignores restated so they survive the override. Formatting stays with Prettier — ESLint carries logic rules only.

items.name: config-prettier
items.title: Prettier Config
items.description: The platform formatting contract — single quotes, semicolons, print width 100, trailing commas, LF. Identical in every repo, so formatting never shows up as noise in a diff.

items.name: page-shell
items.title: Page Shell
items.description: The one page wrapper every route uses: vertical rhythm, the body-size baseline, a content width tier (full/wide/narrow/form) and a header row carrying the breadcrumb, tabs and page actions. Everything app-specific is a slot, so the file is identical in every repo. Implements platform/standards/ui-layout.md. No next/* import — works in any React app.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Light/dark control in the shapes the apps use — a ghost icon button, a labelled Switch row, or both (the shadcn sidebar's collapsed state picks). The icon shows the CURRENT theme and the aria-label names the ACTION; all copy is a prop, since user-facing text follows the product's language.

items.name: test-no-emoji
items.title: Gate: No Emoji
items.description: Turns the platform's no-emoji rule into a failing test that names every offending file:line. Roots and deliberate exceptions live in docs/gates.json, so the test file stays identical in every repo. Installing it into an existing app is a MIGRATION, not a copy — it lands red on whatever drift is already there.

items.name: truncate
items.title: Truncate
items.description: Smart single-line clamp — shows the tooltip only when the text actually overflows.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: The shared "nothing here yet" box: dashed border + icon + title + description + action, or free-form children when the copy is rich.

items.name: icon-tooltip
items.title: Icon Tooltip
items.description: Read-only tooltip for icon buttons — replaces every title= attribute. Short content on hover/focus.

items.name: info-hint
items.title: Info Hint
items.description: An info icon that opens a Popover on click/tap — replaces long inline descriptions, touch- and a11y-friendly.

items.name: info-tooltip
items.title: Info Tooltip
items.description: An info icon showing its description in a tooltip on hover/focus — the minimal sibling of info-hint; wraps and clamps. For titles and labels.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Fade + slide-up on entering the viewport, pure CSS, respects reduced-motion.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Wraps label + control + hint/info for forms; cells fill a sm:grid-cols-2 grid.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Popover + Calendar, value is a local "YYYY-MM-DD" string. Date helpers inlined.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Typed input + a Popover of time presets (15 min), value is a local "HH:MM" string. Time helpers inlined.

items.name: skeletons
items.title: Skeletons
items.description: Skeleton set (PageHeader/Card/List/Grid) matching the standard card stock — for loading.tsx.

items.name: data-pagination
items.title: Data Pagination
items.description: Controlled pagination (page/pageCount/onPageChange) + an ellipsis page window + an optional rows-per-page select; works for client- or server-side paging.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Consistent page header: eyebrow + h1 + description (as an info tooltip) + action + back-link. Next-only (next/link).

items.name: app-sidebar
items.title: App Sidebar
items.description: Config-driven navigation sidebar on the shadcn sidebar primitive: collapses to an icon rail (Cmd/Ctrl+B), switches to a Sheet on mobile, persists its state in a cookie, per-item tooltip when collapsed. Takes brand + groups (lucide icons) + footer. Next-only (next/link + navigation).

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Parent-to-child navigation trail: each crumb carries an icon + a description tooltip; the last one marks the current page.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Config-driven CRUD table on TanStack Table: multi-column sort (Shift-click), draggable column widths, show/hide columns, global search, a filter slot, a row-number column, multi-row selection + an app-supplied bulk action bar, and pagination — the whole view persisted to sessionStorage and mirrored to the URL. The app supplies columns (any cell renderer: edit/delete/badge) + the filters.
